title: Pay $10.00 USDC to mint a PunksinaPunk NFT for a subject address. The API verifi
description: Pay $10.00 USDC to mint a PunksinaPunk NFT for a subject address. The API verifies the x402 payment, checks that the subject has not already been minted, then calls mint() on the ERC-721 contract on your behalf. One NFT per subject address — permanent, transferable, no royalties. Network: Base Mainnet. Each request mints one NFT and returns on-chain asset and transaction links.
